Netlist has asked the USITC to block imports of the disputed chips and products and order the ⁠companies to stop selling them in the U.S. An ITC judge will hold an evidentiary hearing and issue an initial ruling, subject to review ​by the ​commission.

items.summaryOriginal: U.S. stocks remain deep in the throes of a major rotation heading into the teeth of the second-quarter earnings season, and the traditional August lull that follows, as investors take money from highflying tech sector and spread that cash across a host of old-economy bets. What’s happening alongside that “great rotation,” however, is also interesting, and likely keeping stocks afloat amid the broader tech declines.
items.summaryShort: 미국 주식은 2분기 실적 시즌을 앞두고 투자자들이 고공행진하는 기술 부문에서 자금을 가져와 그 현금을 기존 경제에 투자하는 전통적인 8월 소강 상태로 향하는 큰 순환의 진통 속에 여전히 깊이 빠져 있습니다. 그러나 "대단한 회전"과 함께 일어나고 있는 일도 흥미롭고, 광범위한 기술 하락 속에서도 주식을 계속 유지할 가능…
